notes:
SakuraLauncher 0.2.3 beta

Adds configurable Sakura, Sakura Night and Angelic appearances, wallpaper selection, compact account controls, and an expanded Sakura Studio skin and model editing workspace.

Improves Java profile and content workflows, including the supported Fabric + Iris integration and external JAR installer flow. Third-party mods and loaders remain subject to their own provenance and compatibility.

The macOS Intel and Windows x64 release packages were built locally from the same source revision. The Windows binaries were cross-compiled on macOS; this packaging run does not count as native Windows execution. The user previously confirmed the preview on macOS and Windows, including Fabric + Iris on Windows. This beta release still needs the newly published setup and update packages checked on target devices. Back up important worlds before testing.
